denial_type_rationale: Post-service claim denied with CARC 50 under the payer's imaging clinical guideline; no prior authorization was required.
reasons_for: The follow-up note documents a NEW motor deficit (EHL 5/5 to 4/5, dorsiflexion 5/5 to 4+/5) compared with the initial exam, which is the red flag under Indication B1.
The PT note independently records new heel-walk difficulty, which corroborates the progression.
The MRI found a 9 mm extrusion compressing the L5 root, concordant with the deficit, and was used to plan intervention (Indication C).
reasons_against: Documented conservative care lasted about 4.3 weeks (about 5.4 weeks from symptom onset), short of Indication A's 6 weeks.
The motor deficit is mild (4/5 and 4+/5) and documented on a single follow-up exam, so a reviewer may not consider it 'progressive or severe'.
The payer's reviewer explicitly stated that no red flags were found, so the appeal must point them to the specific exam comparison.
recommended_strategy: Appeal under Indication B1 (progressive neurological deficit) with a side-by-side comparison of the {{VISIT1}} and {{VISIT2}} exams, the PT note corroborating the decline, and Indication C as a secondary basis. File quickly: the deadline is close.
